tom.name: Tom Mortimer
tom.bio: Tom Mortimer is a freelance journalist based in Birmingham, writing about sport, politics and where the two meet, with a particular interest in Hungarian football. His work has appeared in The Guardian and The Independent. He started Eleven because table tennis news is scattered across dozens of sites in half a dozen languages.

michael.name: Michael Dobbs
michael.bio: Michael Dobbs is an England-based writer and devoted table tennis fan. With a keen interest in the game, he enjoys following the sport and exploring the stories, personalities and competitions that shape the table tennis world. His writing reflects a genuine passion for the sport and the community that surrounds it.

michelle.name: Michelle Nemeth
michelle.bio: Michelle Nemeth is an England-based writer and passionate table tennis enthusiast. A keen follower of the sport, she combines her love of table tennis with a writer’s interest in the people, stories and developments that make the game so compelling. She brings enthusiasm and a genuine appreciation of the sport to her writing.
